<?php
function quietNamedCloneCoalesceTarget() { static $counter = 0; $counter = $counter + 1; return $counter; }
class QuietNamedCloneCoalesceGet {
    public function __isset(string $incoming): bool { echo "I;"; return true; }
    public function __get(string $incoming): object { global $reader, $selector, $held; echo "G;"; $saved = $held; $held = null; $reader = null; $selector = "changed"; return $saved; }
    public function __destruct() { echo "RECEIVER;"; }
}
function quietNamedCloneCoalesceRight(): int { echo "BAD_RHS;"; return 9; }
echo quietNamedCloneCoalesceTarget() === 1 ? "WARM;" : "BAD_WARM;";
$seed = quietNamedCloneCoalesceTarget(...);
$middle = clone $seed;
$held = clone $middle;
$seed = null;
$middle = null;
$watch = WeakReference::create($held);
$reader = new QuietNamedCloneCoalesceGet;
$selector = "value";
$answer = $reader->$selector ?? quietNamedCloneCoalesceRight();
echo $answer === $watch->get() ? "SAME;" : "BAD_CLOSURE;";
echo $answer() === 2 ? "RESULT;" : "BAD_RESULT;";
echo quietNamedCloneCoalesceTarget() === 3 ? "STATIC;" : "BAD_STATIC;";
echo $held === null && $reader === null && $selector === "changed" ? "CAPTURE;" : "BAD_CAPTURE;";
unset($answer);
echo $watch->get() === null ? "RETIRED;" : "BAD_OWNER;";
$watch = null;
echo "DONE;";
